label: Inquiry on both reference routes
description: Submit known claims and query the payer-held decisions on routes 00301 and 00300, then query a deliberately non-matching member.
notes: Inquiry may return more than one matching claim because the shared reference payer retains matching submissions until its next clearing.
rationale: Exercises PAS inquiry independently of the submit response.
constraints: The no-match inquiry must return an empty result rather than an error.

provenance.source: SHN Connectathon Test Process 2026-10-14 staff draft; SHN Provider Test Endpoint guide
